This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer stationed at [[Mulvar Sensor Station]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''Although [[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]], the novel contains numerous flashbacks set in earlier years, including [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the officer ordered [[Voort saBinring]], a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] who was working undercover at the station, to clean a fungal stain from the top of the station's perimeter wall. Satisfied with saBinring's progress, the officer returned to the officers' quarters, unaware that the cleaning assignment had enabled saBinring to observe the station's perimeter defenses as part of Wraith Squadron's [[Raid on Mulvar sensor station|operation]].<ref name="MK" />
